tiers.name: Pure Sliding Window (W=4096, No Attention Sink & No Global Layers)
tiers.note: Evicting Token 0 at step 4097 destroys the softmax denominator Attention Sink (PPL explodes to 1,240.0) and loses 93.5% of 128K retrieval!

tiers.name: StreamingLLM (SWA W=4096 + 4 Pinned Sink Tokens, 0 Global Layers)
tiers.note: Pinning 4 sink tokens + relative in-window RoPE prevents PPL collapse (6.45), but tokens evicted from the 4K window are forgotten (12% NIAH recall)!

tiers.name: 5:1 Hybrid SWA:Global Model With Naive Uniform 128K Paged KV Allocator
tiers.note: Achieves 99.4% 128K recall, but uniform KV allocation stores all 128K tokens for the 50 SWA layers too -> wastes 32.75 GB/req (81.9% waste)!

tiers.name: 5:1 Hybrid (SWA W=1024+4 Sink : 1 Global) + Split Circular-SWA / Full-Global KV Pool
tiers.note: Allocates circular (W+block) ring pages for 50 SWA layers (0.58 GB) and full 128K pages only for 10 Global layers (6.67 GB) -> 7.25 GB (5.52x smaller) & 99.4% recall!
